title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
provenance_note: Official author archive. Cover says October 2010, but the available file contains later updates. Reprinted forecast passages are used for attribution; the author’s favorable self-grades are not independent outcome evidence. Original book editions were not inspected. Page locators below are PRINTED pages, not PDF viewer indices.

title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
provenance_note: Attributed to Kurzweil; closing note identifies adaptation from The Age of Spiritual Machines (1999). An article mirror, not a scan of the book. Text transcription may contain errors. The article’s dollar amounts must not silently replace differently quoted book versions.

title: Long Bets #1 — Kapor/Kurzweil Turing-test agreement
provenance_note: Kapor takes the NO side; Kurzweil takes the opposing side. Detailed test conditions belong to this contract, not to every generic use of “Turing test.”

title: So what is the singularity? — Ray Kurzweil Q&A
provenance_note: Page identifies the dialogue as 2005. Store dialogue year 2005 separately from archive publication date 2011. Not a checked scan of the 2005 book.

title: AI escape velocity: A conversation with Ray Kurzweil
provenance_note: Bessemer hosts the interview and timestamped transcript. Do not attribute interviewer comments to Kurzweil. The Q&A section is explicitly summarized; cited passages below are in the main transcript.

title: Ray Kurzweil: Universal basic income will arrive in the 2030s
provenance_note: Secondary, contemporaneous attribution of a TED appearance. Original event transcript was not obtained; lower attribution confidence. Not used as technical outcome evidence.

title: Solar power to rule in 20 years, futurists say
provenance_note: Archived event reporting, not an original talk transcript. Review must distinguish solar from all renewables and energy from electricity.

title: IBM — Deep Blue

title: Excerpts of the President’s address to the nation
provenance_note: Describes active human fighting and plans for 30,000 additional US troops in Afghanistan in early 2010. Do not date those additional deployments to 2009.

title: Automated Vehicle Safety — NHTSA
provenance_note: Live guidance checked for this review. Describes limited operating areas for automated fleets and driver-attention requirements of consumer vehicles; not a historical 2009 market census.

title: Cornell meets DARPA Urban Challenge
provenance_note: Closed-course research challenge, not everyday automated public-highway infrastructure.

title: Mortality in the United States, 2019 — CDC Data Brief 395
provenance_note: Final US period life expectancy for 2019: 78.8 years. A national period measure, not a prediction of a newborn cohort’s eventual lifespan.

title: Mortality in the United States, 2024 — CDC Data Brief 548
provenance_note: Final US period life expectancy for 2024: 79.0 years. Do not call this a 2026 observation.

title: TOP500 — November 2009 list
provenance_note: Jaguar Rmax 1.759 petaflops; Rpeak 2.331 petaflops. Rmax is measured LINPACK performance, not brain emulation.

title: TOP500 — November 2012 list
provenance_note: Sequoia Rpeak 20.13266 petaflops and Rmax 16.32475; Titan Rpeak 27.11255 and Rmax 17.59. Peak and measured values must not be mixed.

title: TOP500 — June 2013 highlights
provenance_note: Tianhe-2 recorded 33.86 petaflops Rmax. This establishes a public measured milestone, not a cognition milestone.

title: Large Language Models Pass the Turing Test — Jones and Bergen
provenance_note: Five-minute experimental protocol. GPT-4.5 with a humanlike persona was judged human in 73% of the reported comparisons. Not the two-hour Long Bets protocol.

title: ECG app and irregular rhythm notification available on Apple Watch
provenance_note: AFib-related features are limited-purpose. The release expressly lists conditions they cannot detect; not general diagnosis or autonomous treatment.

title: What educators need to know about cochlear implants — FDA
provenance_note: Cochlear implants do not restore normal hearing. Used to correct a medical error in our intake, not to manufacture a Kurzweil forecast.

title: Waymo opens more rides in Denver, San Diego and Tampa
provenance_note: Driverless fleet operations exist. Regional launches do not establish elimination of most human driving or a road-controlled intelligent-highway system.

title: iRobot reports third-quarter financial results
provenance_note: Cumulative robot sales are not a household adoption rate; use only as capability/deployment evidence.
